name: The Air Is Mine
choreography: Gather palms at the waist, inhale and lift the wrists, hold close to the chest, then open a broad curtain with both hands on the first active frame. Guide the stationary field with one hand high and one low, relax the wrists and return to the approved drifting idle. The field lives on a separate saved clock and reacts to actual contacts.
requirements: Largest limb separation at first active curtain release
Consistent slim anatomy and toe registration
Independent stationary cloud loop, actual-contact pulse accents
Keep near, middle and far placement
Caster recovers normally, no captured sequence
Cloud clears when Smoke is hit
Native hit, block, whiff, mirrored and placement review
